prompt:
Turn this into a carousel. Platform: both Instagram and LinkedIn. Goal: comments.

Raw notes from a talk about productivity and time-blocking.

assertions.text: Output contains a CAROUSEL OVERVIEW section with topic, platform, goal, format, and slide count
Exactly 3 hook options are provided (curiosity, contrarian, direct benefit)
A dedicated CTA final slide is present
No banned words appear in slide copy (leverage, synergy, game-changer, optimize, utilize, basically, literally, etc.)
Both Instagram and LinkedIn platform variation notes are included
CTA is oriented toward comments (e.g. 'comment', 'drop a reply', 'let me know below')
Hook is fresh and was not directly lifted from the original raw notes
An ENGAGEMENT STRATEGY section is present
